her-character.q: How do I change her name?
steps: Type the new name in Name at the top of this page.
Click anywhere outside the box: it saves by itself.
Her notes about herself follow the new name.

her-character.q: How do I make her my own?
steps: Press ✨ Create your companion for a guided setup (about 5 minutes).
Or pick a character under Start from a character and press Use this.
Nudge the personality dials until the sample line sounds like her.

her-character.q: How do I go back to how she was?
steps: Press Undo changes in the bar at the bottom.
It brings back how she was when you opened this page.

her-relationship.q: How do I change what we are to each other?
steps: Pick a card under Your relationship.
Add your own words in the box below it if you like.
Press Try it to hear how she'd react.

her-relationship.q: How do I make her less jealous?
steps: Find Jealousy under the dials.
Move it to the left; the line above it shows how she'd sound.
She is never controlling, whatever the dial says.

her-look.q: How do I give her a new face?
steps: Describe the look and pick a Style.
Press Make a picture, then Use this look when you like it.
Or press Bring my picture to life to start from a photo.

her-look.q: How do I change her outfit?
steps: Under Outfits and places, describe the outfit.
Press Try it on.
Keep favorites in the Closet.

her-voice.q: How do I pick her voice?
steps: Choose a voice under Her voice.
Press Preview to hear it.
It saves by itself; voice notes and calls use it.

her-voice.q: How do I talk to her out loud?
steps: Choose how she hears you under Hearing you.
Then press the microphone in the chat box and speak.

her-hey.q: How do I turn on Hey Sara?
steps: Open this page in the Sara app on your Windows PC or Android phone.
Switch on Listen for “Hey Sara”, read what it does, and allow the download and the microphone.
Say “Hey Sara” and ask; the dot on her icon turns bright while she hears you.

her-hey.q: How do I talk to her without saying her name?
steps: On Windows, press the talk shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Space) or choose Talk to Sara in the tray.
On Android, use the Talk to Sara tile in Quick Settings.
It works even with Hey Sara off: nothing listens until you press it.

her-hey.q: How do I stop her listening on a device?
steps: Press Stop listening next to it under Your devices, from any of your devices.
Or Turn off everywhere for all of them.
Only the device itself can switch it on again.

her-work.q: How do I use her at work in Slack or Teams?
steps: Open Settings → Her → At work.
Tick Use a work profile, and the chats that are work (Slack and Teams are ticked).
Give her a name and tone at work if you like, then press Save.

her-work.q: How do I let her know something at work and at home?
steps: Open Settings → Her → At work.
Under Work memories, find the note.
Press Copy to work or Copy to personal. The original stays where it is.

her-calls.q: How do I choose when she may call me?
steps: Tick what may ring you: reminders, finished tasks, the morning briefing.
Set quiet hours and a limit for calls a day.
Press Call me now to try it.

her-calls.q: How do I stop her calling?
steps: Untick every reason at the top of this page.
She can still send messages; only calls stop.

her-pictures.q: How do I let her send pictures?
steps: Pick a way under Pictures.
For Grok Imagine, paste an xAI API key.
Ask her in chat: "send me a selfie".
Set Pictures to Off.
She will describe instead of sending a picture.

her-companions.q: How do I add another companion?
steps: Type a name under Add a companion and pick where to start from.
Press Add.
Switch between companions from the sidebar.

her-companions.q: How do companions share the Planner?
steps: Under Planner, pick whether to-dos, reminders and notes are shared or their own.
Memories and chats always stay with each companion.

her-companions.q: How do I share a companion with a friend?
steps: Open the ⋯ menu on her row and pick Share her.
Tick what goes in: her memories, your chats and keys never do.
Press Check it, then Save the file or Send to the Sara Store.

her-companions.q: How do I add a companion from a file or a character card?
steps: Press From a file… and choose a companion pack, a character card or a character file.
Read her card: everything that will shape her is on it.
Press Add her: she is a new companion and nobody you have changes.

her-import.q: How do I bring her from another app?
steps: Export your data from that app (ChatGPT, Claude, a character app).
Choose the file under Choose the file.
Tick what to keep, then press Let her read them.

her-import.q: How do I throw an import away?
steps: Before saving, press Never mind.
After a read, press Throw it all away.

you-about.q: How do I change what she calls me?
steps: Type it in What should Sara call you?
It saves when you leave the box.

you-about.q: How do I switch between company and coding?
steps: Pick under What you mostly do with her.
It changes what you see first and the tour; nothing is taken away.

you-about.q: How do I change the language?
steps: Pick a Language for the app.
Pick Talk to me in for her replies.

you-appearance.q: How do I change the colors of the app?
steps: Pick a palette card at the top of this page.
Night or Day picks light or dark for it.

you-appearance.q: How do I get the old rose and violet look back?
steps: Pick Sara Classic as the palette.
Decoration turns the glow and moving light back on.

you-briefing.q: How do I get a morning briefing?
steps: Switch the briefing on and pick a Time.
Set Weather for to your town.
Press Send one now to see it.

you-briefing.q: How do I get a weekly review?
steps: Switch on Weekly review and pick the day and time.
She looks back at your week in chat.

you-leave-by.q: How do I get leave-by reminders?
steps: Type your Home address.
Pick how you're Getting there by.
Events with a place get a Leave by row on Today.
Raise Extra minutes.
Every leave-by time moves that much earlier.

you-adult.q: How do I turn on adult mode?
steps: Press Turn on adult mode and confirm you're 18 or older.
It works only in a web browser, not in the phone apps.

you-adult.q: How do I turn it off again?
steps: Press Turn off adult mode.
Conversations go back to normal right away.

models-default.q: How do I choose the model she thinks with?
steps: Pick a Provider.
Pick a Model from its list.
Anything without its own model uses this one.

models-default.q: How do I see new models?
steps: Press ↻ Refresh.
New models on that provider show up in the list.

models-default.q: How do I tidy a long chat?
steps: Type /compact in the chat, or press Tidy this chat on her panel.
The older part becomes a summary she reads; nothing is deleted and Undo brings it back.

models-routes.q: How do I let Sara pick models for each job?
steps: Press ✨ Use recommended.
Check the rows; change any with its list.

models-routes.q: How do I test a model on one job?
steps: Pick the model in that job's row.
Press Test to see its speed and an answer.

models-providers.q: How do I add a model service with a key?
steps: Pick a Template.
Paste the API key.
Press Save provider.

models-providers.q: How do I add my own Ollama on another computer?
steps: Pick the Ollama template.
Set Base URL to that computer's address.
Press Save provider.

models-subs.q: How do I use my ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan?
steps: Press the sign-in button for your plan.
Finish the sign-in in the browser tab that opens.
Pick the model in Default model.

models-subs.q: How do I sign out of a plan?
steps: Press Sign out under that plan.

models-local.q: How do I download a model to this computer?
steps: Pick one under Model to download (the first fits your computer).
Press Download this model.
Use it in Default model when it's done.

models-local.q: How do I free up space?
steps: Remove a model you don't use from its row.
Ollama deletes its files.

ab-store.q: How do I add something from the store?
steps: Search or pick it on a shelf, then open it.
Read what it can do, then press Get.
Read its card and press Install: it stays off until you switch it on.

ab-store.q: How do I update an add-on?
steps: Open My add-ons.
Press Update next to it and read what changed.
Nothing updates by itself.

ab-store.q: How do I send the Sara team my plugin?
steps: Press Submit yours.
Give the folder, then press Check it.
Fix what it finds, then send it: the team reviews it before it is listed.

ab-tools.q: How do I make her ask before she does something?
steps: Find the tool in its group.
Set it to Ask me first.
Approval cards then appear in chat.

ab-tools.q: How do I switch a tool off?
steps: Find the tool in its group.
Set it to Off.

ab-skills.q: How do I teach her a skill?
steps: Press New skill.
Write the steps in plain words and save.
She uses it when a request matches.

ab-skills.q: How do I add a skill from someone else?
steps: Press Add a skill.
Pick a zip, a GitHub link or a file.
Read it before switching it on.

ab-plugins.q: How do I add a plugin?
steps: Press Add a plugin.
Read the permissions it asks for.
Switch it on when you trust it.

ab-plugins.q: How do I stop a plugin?
steps: Switch it off on its card.
Its log stays under What it did.

ab-plugins.q: How do I try a workflow candidate?
steps: Open Workflow candidates and read Details and limits.
Press Review local candidate, inspect its exact permissions and trust warning, then Install only if you agree.
It stays off for every companion. Enable it separately on its installed card.

ab-plugins.q: How do I use a starter guide?
steps: Open Starter guides under Workflow candidates.
Read its members, qualification, privacy, costs and setup checklist.
Follow existing Settings links and review each member separately. Nothing installs as a group.

ab-search.q: How do I let her search the web?
steps: Pick a Search service.
Paste its API key if it needs one.
Ask her to look something up.

ab-search.q: How do I search without a key?
steps: Pick a service marked Free · no key.
Or run your own SearXNG and paste its URL.

ab-library.q: How do I give her a document?
steps: Open Library from the sidebar.
Drop the file on the box at the top.
Ask her about it in any chat.

ab-library.q: How do I make reading gentler on my computer?
steps: Pick Gentle under Background reading.
Big documents then take longer.

ab-google.q: How do I connect Gmail and Calendar?
steps: Paste your Google Client ID and secret.
Press Save, then Sign in with Google.
Press Sign out of Google.

ab-mail.q: How do I add an Outlook or Microsoft 365 mailbox?
steps: Under Microsoft, follow the numbered steps to make your own Microsoft app.
Paste its client ID and secret, then press Save.
Press Sign in with Microsoft and allow Sara.

ab-mail.q: How do I add Yahoo, iCloud or another mailbox?
steps: Under Add another provider, pick your provider.
Make an app password with the steps shown, then paste it.
Press Add and check.

ab-mail.q: How do I choose which mailbox she uses first?
steps: In the list of mailboxes, press Make default on the one you want.

ab-home.q: How do I connect Home Assistant?
steps: Type the Home Assistant address.
Paste a long-lived access token.
Press Save and test.

ab-home.q: How do I let her notice when I get home?
steps: Connect Home Assistant first.
Under Presence, switch on React to what happens at home.
Pick the people and what she does.
Make an app at developer.spotify.com.
Add the redirect address this page shows.
Paste its Client ID and press Save.
Press Connect Spotify and allow access.

co-spotify.q: How do I let her play music?
steps: Tick Let her control playback.
Press Connect again.
Ask her to play, pause or queue a song.

ab-mcp.q: How do I connect another program (MCP)?
steps: Pick Start from, or type the Command or URL.
Add any Secrets it needs.
Press Save and connect.
A small program that gives her new tools.
Its tools then appear in Tools and approvals.

ab-mcp.q: How do I inspect an MCP recipe preview?
steps: Open Connection investigations and filter the list.
Expand View recipe preview or Why blocked; read prerequisites, scope, costs and qualification.
Prepare configuration yourself in the existing form only after review. Previews do not save, connect or authorize accounts.

ab-mcp.q: How do I verify MCP approval settings?
steps: Inspect each discovered tool in Tools and approvals and select Ask or Off.
Save, leave the page, reopen it and read back the saved permissions.
Repeat after discovery, reconnect and updates. Server read-only annotations can auto-allow calls and do not enforce external-effect approval or cost limits.

ab-projects.q: How do I point her at my project?
steps: Pick a Workspace (your projects folder).
In a chat, press the conversation chip and switch to coding.
Ask: "Look at my project".

ab-projects.q: How do I make her try commands safely?
steps: Switch on Try commands in a sandbox first.
Pick the size and time limits.
Nothing is applied until you choose.

ab-projects.q: How do I check before I ship?
steps: Press Before you ship.
Read the results in Findings.

ab-budgets.q: How do I limit what a coding reply may use?
steps: Under Coding chats, set Tokens, Steps or a Spending limit.
She stops and asks when a reply reaches it.
Choose under Near the limit whether she asks or stops.
Usage and costs shows what was used.

ab-persist.q: How do I make her keep going until the tests pass?
steps: In the chat, press + and pick Keep going until it’s done….
Under Done when, pick the check (the project’s tests are offered first).
Press Start. She works in rounds; Sara runs the check after each one.

ab-persist.q: How do I have her check something every few minutes?
steps: In the chat, press + and pick Repeat this… (or type /loop every 10m: what to check).
Pick how often and until when, then press Start.
She only tells you when something changes; Planner → Repeats lists them all.

ab-precise.q: How do I let her check her edits with my project's own type checker?
steps: Keep Check her edits on at the top of this page.
Under Projects, pick the workspace and set the project to On (or press Check her edits here on the card the first time she changes a file there).
From then on she sees the errors her edit caused in the same reply and fixes them.

ab-precise.q: How do I switch checks off for one project?
steps: Under Projects, pick the workspace.
Set that project to Off.
In a chat app you can also send /problems off.

ab-precise.q: How do I attach a file or my changes to a message?
steps: In the message box, type @ and pick A file, My changes, This branch, Problems or A web page.
Type a few letters to find a file; add :10-25 for just those lines.
Send. The chips under your message show what she got.

ab-when.q: How do I have her remind me when someone comes up?
steps: In any of your chats, say “when Dan comes up, remind me he owes me $20” (or type /when Dan: he owes me $20).
A card under her reply shows it, with Undo.
The next time you mention Dan in one of your own chats, she brings it up once.

ab-when.q: How do I see or forget what she is waiting to bring up?
steps: Open Planner → Reminders → When it comes up.
Press Forget next to one; Done lists the ones that already came up.
Or type /when for the list and /when forget 1.

co-pickup.q: How do I pick up a chat from Telegram in the app?
steps: Open the app after talking on Telegram: a banner offers to pick it up.
Press Continue here (or type /continue in any of your chats).
The chip at the top says where it came from; Undo takes it away.

co-pickup.q: How do I stop the pick-up offers?
steps: Under When I switch apps, choose Only when I type /continue.
To end one pickup, press Undo on its chip (or type /continue off).

co-continuity.q: How do I turn session continuity on or off?
steps: Open Settings → Chat apps → Session continuity.
Switch Use context across my sessions on or off; it saves automatically.
Off stops new context but keeps saved notes. Pick up across apps and While she's working keep their own settings.

co-continuity.q: How do I read the notes from my other sessions?
steps: Close Settings and open one of your own eligible chats with this companion.
Press the conversation chip at the top, then find Saved session context.
Press Show saved session context to see the source, time, expiry and notes.
Notes help later replies; they do not send messages or confirm completed work.

co-continuity.q: How do I clear saved notes, including expired ones?
steps: In This conversation, show the saved session context first.
Choose Clear saved context, review the confirmation, then Confirm clear; Cancel or Escape leaves the notes alone.
Clear also removes expired saved notes while continuity is off; only this session's saved notes are removed.
Original chats, old run records, exports and backups stay.
If the notes changed elsewhere, reload and review them before trying again.

ab-github.q: How do I add a GitHub token?
steps: Make a token on GitHub (Settings → Developer settings).
Paste it in GitHub token.
Press Save.

ab-github.q: How do I turn issues into tasks?
steps: Under Issues become tasks, set a label.
Press Look now to fetch them.

ab-ssh.q: How do I connect a server?
steps: Type the server address and your user name under Connect a server.
Press Connect and wait while Sara looks at it.
Say yes to its ID card, then follow the way in she picks.

ab-ssh.q: How do I connect a cPanel server?
steps: In cPanel, make an API token called sara that expires tomorrow.
Copy it and paste it into the cPanel token box.
Press Install my key: Sara installs her key and deletes the token.
Read the box under the button you pressed.
Press the button it offers, like Find the port or Check now.

ab-ssh.q: Does she ask before running commands there?
steps: Yes, every command asks first by default.
Change it in Tools and approvals.

co-phone.q: How do I put her on my phone?
steps: Open Sara in your phone's browser and sign in.
Press Install Sara as an app (or Add to Home Screen).
Then turn on notifications.
Press Turn on for this device.
Press Send a test.

desktop-app.q: How do I ask her from anywhere?
steps: Pick a Quick ask shortcut.
Press it in any app and type.

desktop-app.q: How do I check notifications work?
steps: Press Show a test notification.

co-computer.q: How do I let her use this computer?
steps: Allow her under This computer.
Choose when she must ask first under Her actions.
Move the mouse to take over any time.

co-computer.q: How do I stop her right away?
steps: Move the mouse or press a key.
She stops and waits.

co-telegram.q: How do I get her on Telegram?
steps: Press Start and open @BotFather.
Send /newbot and paste the key it gives you.
Press Link my Telegram and send the bot the code.

co-telegram.q: How do I add her to a group?
steps: Add the bot to the group in Telegram.
Choose who may talk to her under Remote work and groups.

co-discord.q: How do I get her on Discord?
steps: Make an app and bot in the Discord Developer Portal.
Paste its token in Bot token.
Press Link my Discord.

co-discord.q: How do I stop bot loops?
steps: Under Other bots, keep replies to bots low.
1 means she answers a bot once, then waits for a person.

co-signal.q: How do I get her on Signal?
steps: Press Start and follow the six steps: each turns ✓ when Sara has checked it.
Step 3 gives the exact signal-cli command for this computer.
Press Link my Signal and send her the code.

co-signal.q: Why did she stop using her tools on Signal?
steps: Your safety number changed.
Press It's me in Signal settings if it was you.

co-email.q: How do I give her an email address?
steps: Press Start and pick her mail provider.
Press Add email, then type her address and the app password.
Press Link my email and send her the code as the subject.

co-email.q: Why didn't she answer my email?
steps: Your mail didn't pass your provider's sender check.
Press Check my sender in Email settings and send her a mail.

co-whatsapp.q: How do I text her on WhatsApp?
steps: Tick the box about Meta's rules and press Start.
Follow the ten steps: each turns ✓ when Sara has checked it.
Press Link my WhatsApp and send her the code from your phone.

co-whatsapp.q: Why didn't her reminder come to WhatsApp?
steps: Meta only lets her write first within 24 hours of your last message.
Write to her on WhatsApp to open the window again.
Until then her messages stay in the app.

co-whatsapp.q: A step stays red. What now?
steps: Read the line under the step: it says what to fix.
Press This screen looks different if Meta's page doesn't match.
Press Test to see the first step that fails.

co-matrix.q: How do I talk to her on Matrix?
steps: Tick the box about Matrix and press Start.
Make her a Matrix account, then log her in to Sara with it.
Make a room without encryption in Element, invite her and send the code from Link my Matrix.

co-matrix.q: Why doesn't she answer in my Matrix room?
steps: She can't read encrypted rooms, and Element encrypts new rooms and direct messages by default.
Make a new room with Enable end-to-end encryption switched off and invite her.
Rooms she can't read are listed on the Matrix card.

co-matrix.q: Element says Unknown command when I type /new. What now?
steps: Press Send as message: she gets it as a command.
Or put her name first: Sara new, Sara help.

co-imessage.q: How do I text her from my iPhone?
steps: You need a Mac that stays on. Tick the box about Apple and BlueBubbles and press Start.
Give her an Apple ID and a user on the Mac, sign her in to Messages and install BlueBubbles.
Paste the BlueBubbles password, press Ring, then send the code from Link my iMessage to her address.

co-imessage.q: Why won't she run on my own Apple ID?
steps: On your Apple ID she would see all your chats and her answers would go out as you.
Make a separate Apple ID for her and sign it in to Messages as a separate user on the Mac.

co-imessage.q: Why do her iMessage answers take a few seconds?
steps: BlueBubbles can't ring Sara, so she checks for messages every few seconds instead.
Put the Mac and Sara on Tailscale, then press Ring on the iMessage card.

co-slack.q: How do I talk to her in Slack?
steps: Press Start on the Slack card, then copy the app manifest it shows.
At api.slack.com/apps, create an app from that manifest, make the two tokens and paste them into the card.
Press Link my Slack and send her the code in a Slack DM.

co-slack.q: How do I let her answer in a Slack channel?
steps: In the channel, type /invite and her name.
In Settings → Chat apps → Slack, press Answer here next to that channel.
Mention her in the channel; she answers in a thread.

co-teams.q: How do I talk to her in Microsoft Teams?
steps: Press Start on the Microsoft Teams card and make the free Azure Bot it describes.
Paste the App ID, the tenant ID and a client secret, give Teams a public address and paste the messaging endpoint into the bot.
Download the Teams app package, upload it in Teams, then press Link my Teams and send her the code.

co-teams.q: How do I let her answer in a Teams channel?
steps: Add her app to the team (Apps → her app → Add to a team).
Mention her once in the channel, then press Answer here next to it in Settings → Chat apps → Microsoft Teams.
Mention her again; she answers in that thread.

co-apps.q: How do I use her from my editor?
steps: Press Create an API key for another app.
Copy her address and the key into your editor or tool.
Pick Sara as the model there.

co-apps.q: How do I talk to her through Alexa?
steps: Follow Talk to her through Alexa.
Press Make a link code and say it to Alexa.

co-agents.q: How do I let another agent talk to her?
steps: Under Give an agent a key, press Make a key.
Copy her agent card address and the key to that agent.

co-agents.q: How do I add an agent she can ask?
steps: Paste its address under Add an agent she can ask.
Press Look it up.

co-hooks.q: How do I make a webhook?
steps: Press New webhook.
Pick what sends it and what she does.
Copy its address into the other app.

co-hooks.q: How do I see what a webhook got?
steps: Open the webhook's card.
Look at its deliveries.

dh-usage-report.q: How do I see who used how much?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Usage reports.
Pick Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
Tick Who, Workspace, Project or Model to split the rows.

dh-usage-report.q: How do I get the numbers into a spreadsheet?
steps: Set the period and what to split by.
Press Download CSV.

dh-usage-report.q: How do I get warned before a budget runs out?
steps: Under Monthly budgets, pick a person or a workspace.
Enter dollars or tokens for the month.
Pick when to warn and press Add budget.

dh-trust.q: How do I see what Sara claimed against what ran?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Trust report.
Pick A week, One run or One project.
Press Show and read Claims checked and Failed tools.

dh-trust.q: How do I give the report to a reviewer?
steps: Show the report you want.
Press Markdown, PDF or Word under Download.

dh-shares.q: How do I share a conversation?
steps: Open the chat and its settings.
Press Share….
Check the preview, pick how long the link works and press Make link.
Copy the link and send it privately.

dh-shares.q: How do I stop a link from working?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Shared links.
Press Revoke next to the link.

dh-shares.q: How do I share a private chat?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Shared links.
Tick Allow sharing private chats.
Share it from the chat as usual.

dh-audit.q: How do I see who changed a setting?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Audit trail.
Pick Settings under What, or a person under Who.
Each row says when, what, who and where, and whether it was done or refused.

dh-audit.q: How do I give a reviewer a copy?
steps: Set the filters to what the reviewer asked for.
Press Export JSONL or Export CSV.
Give them the ZIP: its manifest holds the SHA-256 and the signature.

dh-audit.q: How do I know nobody edited it?
steps: Press Check the chain.
It says the chain is fine, or the first row that was changed, removed or cut off.

dh-retention.q: How do I delete old chats automatically?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Retention and legal hold.
Under Keep, pick how long chats, memories and files stay.
It runs on the hourly check. Pinned memories always stay.

dh-retention.q: How do I make sure nothing is deleted?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Retention and legal hold.
Tick Hold next to a person, or Hold everything on this server.
Nothing of theirs can be deleted until you untick it, not even by them.

dh-retention.q: How do I give someone a copy of their data?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Retention and legal hold.
Press Download their data next to the person.
Give them the ZIP: it holds only their chats, memories, photos and files.

dh-retention.q: How do I delete one person's data for good?
steps: Release any hold on them first.
Press Delete their data next to the person and confirm.
The receipt (what was deleted, and when) is in the audit trail.

dh-policy.q: How do I stop anyone turning a setting back on?
steps: Open Settings → Household → Policy.
Tick or pick the rule, for example Keep adult mode off.
Press Save the policy. The setting shows Set by your admin everywhere.

dh-policy.q: How do I set up another server the same way?
steps: Press Export JSON here.
On the other server, open Policy and press Import JSON.
Pick the file: it replaces every pin there.

dh-safety.q: How do I check that my setup is safe?
steps: Open Settings and pick Safety check-up (the first page under its group).
Read the top line: Looks safe, Mostly safe or Fix these first.
Each row says what's true now; the ? says why it matters.

dh-safety.q: How do I fix something it found?
steps: Press the fix button on that row (for example Ask me first again).
Read what it changes and whether it can be undone, then press Do it.
Changed your mind? Press Undo under Recent fixes.

dh-safety.q: How do I run the check-up from the command line?
steps: On the server, run: sara doctor --safety
It prints the same rows, the fix for each, and exits 0 (safe), 1 (tighten) or 2 (fix first).
The command line never changes anything; fixes are on this page.

dh-recovery.q: How do I review an interrupted job?
steps: Choose Review restart and read the preview before doing anything else.
Copy it, or use it in the same empty chat; an existing draft is kept.
Choose Send yourself. Earlier effects may repeat; current checks and approvals still apply.

dh-recovery.q: How do I resume an interrupted team?
steps: Check the unfinished step and its receipts; it may already have changed something.
Choose Resume team and acknowledge the risk before resuming. Completed steps are kept.

dh-recovery.q: How do I check an uncertain delivery?
steps: Use Unresolved or All history, then Load more deliveries to reach older records.
Check the destination first. Unknown messages may have arrived; live queued messages may still send.
Record only what you confirmed. Human resolution is separate from platform acknowledgment; this page never resends.

dh-recovery.q: How do I archive old delivery evidence?
steps: Enter an explicit UTC cutoff in Recovery. Preview the eligible records first.
Confirm one batch of up to 500 records. Keep the same cutoff for further batches.
Use Archived to view retained evidence. Unresolved outcomes and deduplication identity are preserved.

dh-health.q: How do I check everything works?
steps: Press Run full check.
Fix anything marked red with its button.

dh-health.q: How do I clear old run history?
steps: Pick how long to Keep runs.
Or press Delete run history.

dh-devices.q: How do I sign in on another phone or computer?
steps: Press Add a phone or computer.
Scan the code or type it there.

dh-devices.q: How do I lock out a lost device?
steps: Press Sign out all other devices.
Or make a new token with Make a new token.

dh-backups.q: How do I make a backup now?
steps: Press Back up now.

dh-backups.q: How do I keep a copy somewhere else?
steps: Pick where under Copy backups to.
Fill in the folder or bucket and a passphrase.
Press Copy the latest backup now, then Test restore now.

dh-backups.q: How do I prove a backup really restores?
steps: Open Readiness and recovery (Data & health) and press Run a restore drill.
Sara restores the newest backup into a throwaway copy, checks it, starts it and deletes it; your live data is not touched.
Read the result: how long it took, what it counted and how much a restore now would lose.
Under Export and import, press Export all data.
Keep the file somewhere safe.

dh-data.q: How do I bring my chat history from another app?
steps: Under Bring your history, pick the export file.
Press Import and check the preview.

dh-movein.q: How do I move in from another agent?
steps: Press Copy the command and run it where that agent lives.
Or press Make a move-in code.
Check each card before it's saved.

dh-movein.q: How do I undo a move-in?
steps: Find it under Past move-ins.
Press Undo this move-in.
Press Check for updates.
Press Update now when a new version shows.

dh-updates.q: How do I see what changed?
steps: Press What's new in each version.

dh-usage.q: How do I see what she costs?
steps: Read the top line for today.
Open By model or By what it was for for details.

dh-usage.q: How do I set a spending limit?
steps: Open Budgets on this page or Coding → Budgets.
Set a limit per job or per day.

dh-privacy.q: How do I see what the check-in sends?
steps: Press Show what's sent.

dh-privacy.q: How do I stop the daily check-in?
steps: Switch the check-in off on this page.
Press Reset the install ID to start fresh.

dh-reports.q: How do I report a problem?
steps: Press Report a problem.
Say what happened; add diagnostics if you like.
Press Send.

dh-reports.q: How do I see what happened to my report?
steps: Each report shows its status and replies here.
Type their name under Invite someone.
Press Make invite, then Copy link and send it.

household.q: How do I limit what they use?
steps: Set Messages a day and Spending a day.
Choose the models they may use.

account.q: How do I sign in on another device?
steps: Press Devices and sign-in.

account.q: How do I delete my account?
steps: Press Delete my account and confirm.
Your companion, chats and memories go.
Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter.
Or tap one of the suggestions above.

chat.q: How do I send her a photo or a file?
steps: Press the paperclip next to the box.
Pick the file; add a line if you like.

chat.q: How do I switch this chat to coding?
steps: Press the chip at the top of the chat.
Pick a workspace and switch the mode to coding.

chat.q: How do I use the / commands?
steps: Type / at the start of the message box.
Pick one with ↑ ↓ and Enter, or keep typing to narrow the list.

today.q: How do I plan my day with her?
steps: Press Plan my day with her.
She looks at your list, calendar and weather.

today.q: How do I change what Today shows?
steps: Press Customize.
Switch sections on or off and drag them in order.

today.q: How do I set up a routine?
steps: Press Add a routine, or open Planner → Routines.
Pick a card, answer its questions, look at the preview, then press Turn on.

planner.q: How do I add a to-do?
steps: Type it in the box under To-do and press Add.
Or just tell her in chat: "add milk to my list".

planner.q: How do I set a reminder?
steps: Open Reminders, type what and when.
Or tell her: "remind me at 5 to call Ana".

planner.q: How do I review my week?
steps: Press Review my week.

planner-reminders.q: How do I set a reminder for a time?
steps: Type what and when at the top of Reminders, then press Add.
Or tell her in chat: "remind me at 5 to call Ana".

planner-reminders.q: How do I get reminded when something comes up?
steps: Under When it comes up, type what to remind you of.
Pick a person, or type a few words to listen for.
Press Add. She tells you when they come up in a chat.

planner-repeats.q: How do I make her check something on a timer?
steps: In a chat, press + and pick Repeat this….
Pick how often and until when, then press Start.
Or type /loop every 10m: what to check.

planner-repeats.q: How do I pause or stop a repeat?
steps: Find it in this list.
Press Pause, or Stop to end it.

planner-repeats.q: How do I change how much repeats may spend?
steps: Open Settings → Coding → Keep going and repeats.
Pick Careful, Normal or Long jobs.

planner-routines.q: How do I turn on a routine?
steps: Pick a card under Add a routine.
If it says Set up first, press it and connect what it needs.
Answer its questions, look at the preview, then press Turn on.

planner-routines.q: How do I switch a routine off?
steps: Under My routines, switch it off. It stops at once.

memory.q: How do I tell her something to remember?
steps: Say it in chat: "remember that I'm allergic to nuts".
Or add a note here.

memory.q: How do I make her forget something?
steps: Find the note (search helps).
Press Forget on it.

library.q: How do I give her a document?
steps: Drop the file on the box at the top, or click it to pick one.
She reads it and keeps the key points.

library.q: How do I ask about a document?
steps: Ask in any chat: "what does the lease say about pets?"
She quotes the part she used.

scrapbook.q: How do I pin a message?
steps: Press 📌 under a message.
It shows here with the pins and inside jokes.

scrapbook.q: How do I keep an inside joke?
steps: Tell her: "that's our inside joke now".
Or add it here.

moments.q: How do I keep a moment?
steps: Press ♡ under a message or a photo.
It shows here with a caption she writes.

moments.q: How do I choose which photos land here?
steps: Pick under Add photos: all, only kept moments, or off.

story.q: How do I get a look back?
steps: Pick the dates under Look back.
Press the button; she writes it from what's on this page.

story.q: How do I see where something came from?
steps: Click any entry.
The chat or note it came from opens.

team.q: How do I give the team a job?
steps: Type the goal in the box.
Press Start; she plans and hands parts to helpers.

team.q: How do I stop a helper?
steps: Open the task.
Press Stop next to the helper, or stop the whole task.
Her security pass after coding turns adds them.
Dependency checks and sandbox tries add them too.
Open the finding.
Press Fix on a branch: she tries it on its own branch.

evals.q: How do I try other settings?
steps: Under Try other settings, pick past tasks and variants.
Check the estimate, then start.

evals.q: How do I read the result?
steps: Each variant is scored next to your settings.
A winner is named only when the evidence says so.

dh-operations.q: How do I check local operations?
steps: Open Operations and press Refresh operations.
Read the measurement window and sample count. HTTP timings are not model reply timings.
A configured model and a saved backup do not prove inference or recovery.

dh-operations.q: How do I tell active work from historical records?
steps: Record totals include finished history. State counts show queued and running work; delivery records can include archived evidence.
RSS and event-loop lag are process-wide, including other spaces and HTTP servers in this process. They are not current-space usage.
